task: Measure production compiler build time on the accepted Phase 25.1 baseline for Phase 25.2 G0.
observation: In the clean O0 rerun, five `make moss-dev` builds had a 31.98-second median and five link-only runs had a 0.37-second median. GCC 13.3 `-ftime-report` attributed a median 24.52 seconds (69% of its instrumented total) to `phase opt and generate`; five O2 runs could not be completed after the user stopped further measurement.
impact: The completed O0 data identifies compilation as the current build bottleneck, while the incomplete O2 set prevents an optimization-profile comparison or a complete G0 baseline claim.

resolution.summary: O0 production measurements are complete; clean O2 measurements and phase reports remain incomplete due to the explicit stop instruction.
